decisions.reason: Reviewing the wording of a draft copyright transfer certificate does not change the selected logo or any visual-design attributes.
The requested certificate review is a separate legal-documentation process and does not alter the completed logo concept or revision process.
Emailing a draft certificate for wording review does not change the required logo asset formats or their usability.
The certificate wording review has no effect on the required font identification or complementary-font guidance.
The copyright certificate review does not modify the required background-box or colour variants of the logo.
